evidence: The dispersion of the nano-TiO2 fillers in the PA matrix was examined using a transmission electron microscope (TEM) JEOL, model JEM 2010... The surfaces of broken tensile test specimens were examined with a scanning electron microscope (SEM) Philips XL 30... Compositional data were obtained with an energy dispersive spectrometer (EDS) Edax DX-4... Tensile tests were run at room temperature according to ISO 527... Notched Charpy impact strength was measured using a Ceast Resil 5.5 impact tester... The scratch resistance of a coin-shaped PA nanocomposite was characterized with a Nano Scratch Tester by CSM Instruments... The Messphysik (Midi 10-20) universal testing machine was used to determine the sliding friction characteristics of the PA nanocomposites...
